notes.title: HUGE update, physics overhaul, lots of new content!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're quite aware of our game's problems, and we've been working very hard to improve the game, and make it as good as possible.

So we dedicated ourselves 100% to bring the best possible experience for everyone out there, and after all our hard work, we have an entire new version!

Our physics systems are completely revamped and new (which were the main issue with the game's first version), and created A LOT of new content for the game!

The game's length is about an hour now (maybe more, depends on how fast you can solve everything!), with more rooms, an impressive new compound to explore, different (and harder!) puzzles, and a much higher quality level!

Also, exciting news: this version has been selected to run for best VR game at BIG Festival!
We're going against some insane titles, such as Superhot VR. But we're confident we can achieve some great results!

Thanks again for everyone's feedback, it really means the world to see people playing, and talking about our game!

We hope you guys enjoy our new version, and have lots of fun!
